FINDING (high, correctness): Project/fleet dashboard builds and serves do not render the selected project’s F008 inventory in Settings. Evidence: project builds mirror `config-inventory.json` under `state/projects/<name>/` (`projects_dashboard.py:1152-1170`), but `core.js` only loads top-level `state/config-inventory.json` (`core.js:267-271`) and Settings only renders `state.configInventory` (`settings.js:195-198`). `serve_start()` then overwrites the top-level inventory with `project_name=None` (`dashboard.py:1143-1146`), so served project dashboards show machine-scope inventory. Recommendation: load per-project config inventories keyed by selected project, or write the focused project inventory to the top-level served state without dropping project scope.
